newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish end-June budget deficit 700.7 trln lira.
newsitem.headline: Turkish end-June budget deficit 700.7 trln lira.

text.p: Turkey's budget deficit stood at 700.7 trillion lira at the end of June, the finance ministry said in a statement.

The ministry did not provide a breakdown of the income and expenditure on which the deficit figure was based. It said the headline figure included payments that were due in June but have been carried over to July.
Excluding these payments, income in the six months to June totalled 2,135 trillion lira ($13.4 billion) and spending was 2,817 trillion lira.
Revenues at the end of June were up 96.8 percent year-on-year, and expenditure rose 83 percent.
At the end of June 1996, the consolidated budget showed a deficit of 475.4 trillion lira. The year-on-year deficit rise does not account for annual inflation of around 80 percent.
